name: Faber
facts: Deep tech: applied science & digital, climate & ocean
position: Faber is a Lisbon-based deep-tech VC investing at pre-seed and seed across two tracks: applied science and digital transformation, and climate and ocean tech. Beyond capital, it runs a talent board for its portfolio and an Entrepreneurship Program for scientists turning research into companies.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Deep-tech founders spend years getting the science right; I help with what comes next, turning it into a product customers adopt and pay for. Youverse, Passworks, Meight, Equall and Unbabel sit right on top of what I've built.
summary: Faber backs scientists and engineers early, and the hardest step for them is usually the first product and the first revenue engine, not the technology. I've spent nine years on exactly that translation: specs for SDKs and ML systems, discovery with real customers, and the CRM and onboarding stack that lets a young company sell. Your identity, logistics, data and AI-software companies match my background directly, and your talent board is the natural place for someone like me.

reasons.title: Biometrics and identity, shipped
reasons.body: I owned an AI-powered KYC product at Pi Network: ID capture, liveness, human review and bot detection for 14M+ users. That's Youverse's world.

reasons.title: From lab to first customers
reasons.body: I write specs engineers respect (SDKs at HEROW, ML features judged on F1) and run discovery with buyers. That's the bridge your seed-stage founders need.

reasons.title: Made for your talent board
reasons.body: Faber already connects talent with portfolio companies. I'm Lisbon-based, freelance or full-time, and can start with one company or several.
